title: actinostemon concolor var. obovatus
intro: Actinostemon concolor var. obovatus, commonly known as the "False Kola", is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Actinostemon concolor var. obovatus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal applications. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
